text: A growth clinic in Gangnam, South Korea.
zh: 韩国江南的儿童成长诊所。

text: Parents tell us what changed once growth was properly tracked.
zh: 系统管理成长之后，家长们看到了变化。

text: More reviews than we can fit here, from parents across Asia.
zh: 亚洲各地家长的评价，多到这里放不下。

text: Fifteen years of child growth and hormone care.
zh: 十五年儿童成长与激素诊疗经验。

text: Medical, sleep, nutrition, posture, exercise, managed together.
zh: 医疗、睡眠、营养、体态、运动，一同管理。

text: Now you can receive Asia's best growth treatment.
zh: 现在，您也能获得亚洲顶尖的成长治疗。
